text:
rahul: Nightly eval alert — large spike on core promptset. Failure count up from 3 -> 39 on redwood/open-7b-v2-int8 canary 2025-07-09. Quick look: many are hallucinations at prefix boundaries.

jin: saw the alert. which prompts? any common pattern?

eval-bot: nightly-run 2025-07-09 03:12 UTC: model=redwood/open-7b-v2-int8 canary=rev-20250709-α metrics: pset-core-42 fail=18, pset-sys-09 fail=7, pset-kb-11 fail=14; median latency +2ms; token-diffs detected on 29 prompts vs baseline.

sasha: token-diffs is interesting — we had a tokenizer tweak merged yesterday (PR #842: normalize-leading-space). Could that change tokenization of prompts that rely on leading-space anchors?

elaine: yes that PR changed BPE merges for spaces to reduce tokens for short system prompts. It was intended to be benign for decoding. Did we ship the new tokenizer artifact to the canary? 

rahul: AFAIK the canary model build included tokenizer artifact tknr:c1f2d3a (from master). The baseline is tknr:b9e8f7c. I can confirm artifacts.

jin: quick repro: run tokenization on pset-core-42 prompt #7 with both artifacts. I ran locally: baseline -> tokens 23, new -> tokens 22 and the first token differs (space merged into next token). Generated output from canary drops an expected "\nSummary:" anchor, model continues free-form -> hallucination. Repro steps pasted:

```
# repro
python -c "from tkn import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.load('b9e8f7c').encode('PromptA'))"
python -c "from tkn import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.load('c1f2d3a').encode('PromptA'))"
```

sasha: That explains prefix-alignment with KV cache for quantized runtime? If tokenization changed, kv-cache offsets shift and attention windows misalign on resumed sequences.

anna: hmm — but the runtime should be robust to token length changes. Is it a bug in runtime KV indexing when token boundaries change mid-rollout? We did change a cache-compact optimization in the int8 path last month.

rahul: I instrumented a failing trace: when token lengths shorter by 1, the int8 KV compact path copies slices using token indices derived from cumulative token counts; an off-by-one introduced when merging leading-space tokens causes the slice to start 1 token earlier — garbage in memory maps to spurious attention and hallucination. Patch PR #859 re: kv-compact indexing seems to have an interaction.

elaine: TL;DR: combination of tokenizer change + kv-compact index assumption broke some prompts. Two independent changes that force a regression when combined. Root cause: tokenizer normalization changed token boundaries; runtime indexing assumed stable boundaries and had an off-by-one for compacted kv in quantized path.

jin: mitigation plan suggestion:
- immediate: rollback canary to artifact using tokenizer tknr:b9e8f7c and model variant rev-20250702 (previous canary).
- short-term fix: patch kv-compact indexing to use explicit token offsets (PR queued) and run canary.
- gating: add token-diff-check in model onboarding CI comparing tokenized sequences for our core promptset between baseline tokenizer and candidate tokenizer; fail onboarding if any prompt has token boundary diffs or token count delta != 0 for core prompts.
- monitoring: add alert on nightly eval if token-diff count > 5 or fail-rate delta > 5%.

anna: +1. Also add a unit test in runtime that simulates compact path with token boundary changes to avoid regression with quant builds.

rahul: I've triggered rollback on the canary to rev-20250702 and pinned tokenizer to b9e8f7c. Canary health watch started (watch window 30m) — revert is in progress, will post status.

eval-bot: deploy-job 2025-07-09 03:45 UTC: canary redeploy to rev-20250702 started by rahul. Status: in-progress.

sasha: for the long-term: we must treat tokenizer artifacts as part of model contract. Any tokenizer change should require a cross-check against KV assumptions + token alignment tests for core prompt anchors.

jin: I'll open two follow-ups: 1) PR to add token-diff onboarding gating + CI job to compute diffs for core promptsets, 2) PR to make kv-compact path index resilient (uses explicit offsets array). ETA ~1 business day for first, ~2-3 days for runtime fix + tests.

elaine: please file a short postmortem once fixes land — include root cause, triage timeline, and the new gating rules. Also add a note to the onboarding doc that tokenizer artifacts are immutable for a model family unless token-diff gating passes.

rahul: rollback completed: canary stable at rev-20250702, fail counts dropped back to baseline (3 -> 2). Will keep the canary pinned until kv fix + tokenizer gating are in CI. Closing immediate incident.

anna: Action items summarized:
- rahul: keep canary pinned, monitor 8h (done)
- jin: token-diff gating PR + CI job (ETA 1d)
- jin: runtime kv-compact patch + unit tests (ETA 2-3d)
- sasha: update onboarding docs to require tokenizer immutability/gating (ETA 2d)
- elaine: postmortem writeup (ETA 3d)

rahul: adding a short note to incident board and will link the PRs here when created. Thanks team :raised_hands:

anna: nice catch by the token-diff alert. Good to have the watchdogs in place. :thumbsup:
